The '''crystal swamps''' was a location on the planet [[Msst]]<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> in the [[Msst sector/Legends|Msst sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the native population on Msst was forced by the Empire to labor in the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] swamps.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />
